note: Slice-03 member sets, chosen so every level assertion in the feature is falsifiable against the code as it stands today. Every term below is (CV/c)^2 with c1 = 0.25 for height, c2 = 0.20 for period, c3 = 30 degrees for direction (05-scoring-engine.md section 6.1), and DISAGREEMENT_THRESHOLD is 0.5.

split_on_period.label: the models agree on size and direction and split badly on the period: the shape research 09 section 7.5 writes its own sentence from
split_on_period.terms_note: height 0.0224, period 0.9221, direction 0.0711. Only the period clears 0.5, so the reason names el periodo and nothing else. c_spread = exp(-1.0156) = 0.3622.

tight_agreement.label: the models agree on all three variables, so the disagreement term is the only thing carrying any signal at all
tight_agreement.terms_note: height 0.0025, period 0.0007, direction 0.0044. c_spread = exp(-0.0077) = 0.9924, which alone reads alta. That is exactly why switching the term off must not leave an empty product reading 1.0.

verified_track.label: a scorecard row that passed the honesty gates, so track_state reads measured and c_track carries real signal
verified_track.terms_note: c_track = clip(1 - 3/12) = 0.75. With the disagreement term on, 0.3622 x 0.75 = 0.2716, baja. With it off, 0.75 alone, alta. With it off and the tide dark, min(0.75, 0.7) = 0.7, media.
